gates.name: PART1_CLOSURE_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: The exact squash-merged closure commit and independent main CI are recorded, and the frozen tree reproduces Part 1 validation.

gates.name: HANDOFF_AUTHORITIES_BOUND
gates.acceptance: Every inherited Part 1 authority exists at its frozen digest and no protected authority is modified.

gates.name: RUNTIME_SCOPE_OWNED
gates.acceptance: Every required runtime responsibility and master Part 2 gate has one future-stage owner without implementation inflation.

gates.name: TOOLCHAIN_COMPATIBILITY_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Two clean exact Python 3.11.13, Java 17, Spark 3.5.6 runs produce equal checked-arithmetic and Parquet results.

gates.name: FAIL_CLOSED_VALIDATION_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Requirements and traceability are complete, and negative mutations of every critical authority class are rejected.

gates.name: NON_AWS_TRANSITION_PROVEN
gates.acceptance: Automatic CI remains read-only and cannot assume AWS credentials, invoke AWS APIs, or mutate infrastructure.
